changelog:
- Initial release: Enables creation and configuration of a new OpenClaw agent using the OpenClaw CLI.
- Guides users to specify agent purpose, constraints, and desired identity before automated creation.
- Adds non-interactive CLI flow for agent creation, ensuring user confirmation before execution.
- Details strict editing rules for workspace files (IDENTITY.md, AGENTS.md), including safe appending of custom content after separators.
- Provides workflow for syncing identity and setting agent operating rules post-creation.
